<explanation>
Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL examples with query parameters, expecting continuation of the second URL example.

The question concerns URL query parameter ordering, specifically whether `?flag` appearing before `?foo=1&bar=2` matters — the second URL likely demonstrates a contrasting case.

Final token `?flag` is the start of a second URL query string (`https://example.com/?flag`), strongly expecting continuation with either `=value` or `&` plus other parameters, mirroring the first URL's structure but with `flag` positioned differently.
"First URL: `https://example.com/?foo=1&bar=2&flag`
Second URL: `https://example.com/?flag`" — the pattern suggests the next token continues the query string, likely `=value` or a similar parameter name referencing the "flag" concept.</explanation>
